highlights.title: Browsers Kosmos opens keep its keys out
highlights.line: The browser a Kosmos sign-in opens on Windows no longer starts with Kosmos's own keys in its environment.

highlights.title: Spreadsheets reach your agent row by row
highlights.line: Spreadsheets you attach reach your agent row by row, with each value named by its column.

highlights.title: Signing in again keeps your invitation
highlights.line: If Kosmos asks you to sign in again while you invite someone outside, you come back with who it is for already filled in.

highlights.title: A task says how many subtasks are on hold
highlights.line: A task with subtasks now says how many are on hold beside its done count, on the board and in task lists.

highlights.title: Agent browsers left running are closed
highlights.line: From now on, a browser an agent's session leaves running is closed when that agent starts again, so they stop piling up.
